descricao_original: This image of the pancreas shows the apically located secretory granules in the pyramidal-shaped acinar cells that compose the pancreatic acinus. Secretory granules that contain enzymes are specifically called zymogen granules. Also prominent in this field is the basally located, blue-staining RER. 1000x
